generation.promptA:
Create image A for a premium cooperative spot-the-difference game.
Landscape 3:2 composition, fixed camera, richly detailed but visually readable.
Theme: 동물 탐정단의 달빛 등대 지도실 최종 수사. Scene: A grand whimsical 1930s lighthouse chart room on a calm moonlit night just after a storm, viewed straight-on from a comfortable medium-wide angle. Warm amber lamplight mixes with cool blue moonlight through tall curved windows, with the lighthouse's glowing Fresnel lens visible in an upper glass chamber. At the lower-left, the recurring friendly fox detective wears the same burgundy trench coat and studies the room beside a broad wooden chart table. At the lower-right, the recurring friendly rabbit assistant wears the same teal beret and looks through one oversized antique-brass hand telescope whose large eyepiece rim is clearly turquoise. At center on the chart table, one large decorative model sailboat has exactly three broad, clearly separated ivory sails; the middle sail alone is coral red. On the upper-left wall, one oversized round brass compass has one thick coral-red triangular needle pointing straight upward. Across the upper-middle, exactly three large maritime signal pennants hang separately on one rope: a burgundy triangle, a cream swallowtail, and a teal square. At the far right, a friendly owl lighthouse keeper in a midnight-blue coat holds one oversized antique-gold signal lantern whose front window has one clearly visible crescent-moon-shaped opening glowing warm amber. Add blank rolled sea charts without writing, a ship wheel, coiled rope, a brass bell, a raincoat on a peg, distant dark ocean waves, and soft wet-floor reflections only as supporting atmosphere. Keep the turquoise telescope eyepiece, coral center sail, compass needle, three signal pennants, and lantern window large, unobstructed, spatially separated, and away from the outer 3% safe margin. No readable signs, labels, letters, numbers, compass letters, or clock numerals..
Art direction: original premium 1930s-inspired animal detective storybook game illustration, cinematic cozy mystery lighting, clean expressive ink contours, soft cel shading, gently hand-painted paper texture, polished animated-feature background quality, friendly rounded anthropomorphic animals, crisp object silhouettes, cohesive moonlit blue, sepia cream, burgundy, deep teal, warm amber, antique gold, turquoise, coral red, and ivory palette, not imitating any specific artist or franchise.
Do not include text, letters, numbers, logos, signatures, borders, split screens, or watermarks.
Keep important objects away from the outer 3% safe margin.
